label: Order
caption: ARIZONA, ET AL. V. ALEJANDRO MAYORKAS, SECRETARY OF HOMELAND SECURITY, ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, IT IS ORDERED that the November 15, 2022 order of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia, case No. 1:21-cv-00100, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Tuesday, December 20, 2022, by 5 p.m. (EST).
